description: Verify a tool, MCP server, or package BEFORE invoking or installing it. Returns a conservative verdict — trusted | caution | unverified | flagged — with the record's Ed25519-signed trust passport attached (verifiable offline against https://unfragile.ai/api/v1/trust-passport-public-key). RULE: never invoke or install a `flagged` target; treat `unverified` as review-first.

target.description: Target identity, e.g. 'npm:@stripe/mcp', a package name, or a record id

name: unfragile_verify
